content.comment_body: Hello everyone, I have a [product_name], and I'm trying to access its web server by connecting Ethernet directly to my PC. How can I find the IP address, and what is the default login password? Is there any reference material available? Thanks a lot.

The IP address for the web server is the same as your [product_name]. Typically, the default password is [product_name]. To access the web server, ensure that access is granted in the device’s Access Control settings.

To clarify, the IP address used by the web server is identical to the one set for your [product_name], as the embedded web server runs directly on it. The usual default IP address is 192.168.0.1 with a subnet mask of 255.255.255.0.
A new question titled 'Re-Program a [product_name] remotely with [product_name] V[version_no]' has been moved to a separate thread. Best regards, [user_name] (Moderator)

analysis.insight_summary: Users are facing challenges locating the default IP address and password needed to access the embedded web server on the [product_name]. The main concerns include initial setup steps, including obtaining connection details and ensuring proper access permissions. This points to a need for clearer instructions and easier access to configuration information for first-time users.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect concise and direct guidance to identify the default IP address, access the web server, and log in with the default password. They also look for official documentation or reference materials to assist with setup.
